answer_1.quote: we proposed a novel model for contextual response generation in multi-turn dialogue.

answer_2.quote: For response content quality we measured BLEU-4 and Perplexity(PPL). Like in [citation] used embedding metrics average (AVG), extrema (EXT), and greedy (GRE) measuring similarity between response and target embedding. Similar to [citation] we also measured the informativeness of responses with distinct-1 and distinct-2

answer_4.quote: We picked 500 dialogues from the test set and asked 3 native speakers for their judgement. In the first setting, we asked judges to pick the better response among the one generated by our model and a baseline model (Pre-Trained GPT2) based on various criteria like answerability and semantics.
answer_4.guideline: Judges were asked to pick the better response based on criteria like answerability and semantics in single-turn settings, and to decide which conversation has higher quality in multi-turn settings.
